AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. The active instance set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is the instance ProtocolDataProvider). Supersedes the per-instance AaveV3_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11). positionId derived on-chain = the instance Pool; name = PoolAddressesProvider.getMarketId().

AaveV4SpokesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V4 Spoke. Constructor takes only the NAV proxy, so its CREATE2 address is fleet-wide (DeploySalts.AAVE_V4_SPOKES_META = 2 - generation 2; since PR #338 (2026-09-29) the gas-metered MetaBalanceAdapter base moved it to 0xAd5b905ad5BB13909aE658a1910bC4cdFcD81dE3, registered on the live NAV (the pre-#338 gen-2 build 0xdF1B9d57A40D3866F9EFc9d391EDf9dF51325B59 is deregistered with an empty set); generation 1 at salt 1, 0x79cad9584012806a76E7892808556Ed3797EAbcD, is superseded and DEREGISTERED - do not derive or verify against it. Neither generation was ever plain-CREATE deployed). The active Spoke set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from `instances` below - each entry is a Spoke address). Reserves are NOT instances: they are enumerated on-chain per Spoke by numeric id via getReserveCount()/getReserve(id). positionId = the Spoke, which is also the unit a v4 health factor is scoped to.

MorphoVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho ERC4626 vault. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator and is applied via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances in 06_Configure (from `instances` below). This SUPERSEDES the per-vault MorphoVault_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11) — the NAV calculator now learns the Morpho-vault universe from this list.

MorphoMarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho Blue market. The active marketId set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instancesRaw below). Supersedes the per-market MorphoMarket_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

GearboxV3MarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Gearbox V3 ERC4626 farming pool. Emits one Supply leg per market (convertToAssets(balanceOf)) in the pool's underlying. The active market set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is the market/pool address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = market address; name = market name(). Supersedes the per-market GearboxMarket_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

BalancerV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 pool's wallet-held (unstaked) AMM liquidity only. The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is the pool/BPT address). Gauge-staked LP + rewards are the separate BalancerV3GaugesMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the pool address; name = BPT token name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

BalancerV3GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 gauge's staked LP + BAL/extra rewards. The active gauge set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is the gauge address). Wallet-held (unstaked) LP is the separate BalancerV3PoolsMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

BalancerV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 pool's wallet-held BPT, decomposed pro-rata into the underlying tokens (composable-stable BPT-in-pool token excluded; supply via getActualSupply() when present else totalSupply()). The instance coordinate is the raw 32-byte poolId (instancesRaw below), NOT an address — the BPT address is derived on-chain as address(uint160(uint256(poolId) >> 96)). positionId derived on-chain = the BPT address; name = the BPT name(). Gauge-staked BPT is the separate BalancerV2GaugesMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 positions today — the example instance is B-80BAL-20WETH, enable + add poolIds via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstancesRaw when a position is opened.

BalancerV2GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 gauge's staked BPT (decomposed pro-rata like BalancerV2PoolsMeta) + claimable BAL and extra reward tokens. The instance coordinate is the gauge address (instances below); the BPT is read on-chain via gauge.lp_token() and its poolId via getPoolId(). positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Wallet-held (unstaked) BPT is the separate BalancerV2PoolsMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 gauge positions today — the example instance is the B-stETH-STABLE gauge, enable + add gauges via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances when a position is opened.

CurvePoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving wallet-held LP for every configured Curve pool. Instance coordinate = pool address. Supersedes wallet-LP reporting in per-instance Curve_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

CurveGaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving gauge-staked LP + CRV + extra rewards for every configured Curve gauge. Instance coordinate = gauge address. Supersedes staked-LP + reward reporting in per-instance Curve_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

ConvexCurveLPStakingMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Convex pool. Instance coordinate = rewarder (BaseRewardPool) address. LP token resolved on-chain via rewarder.pid() → Booster.poolInfo(pid).lptoken. Emits Supplied legs (staked LP decomposed into Curve pool tokens) + Earned legs (CRV exact, CVX via cliff schedule, extra rewards). Supersedes per-instance Convex_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

FluidFTokensMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Fluid fToken (ERC4626 lending vault). One Supply leg per fToken (convertToAssets(balanceOf)) in its underlying. The active fToken set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is an fToken address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = fToken address; name = fToken symbol(). Supersedes the per-fToken Fluid_fToken_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

FluidVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Fluid T1 vault. Emits a Collateral leg (supply) and a Borrow leg (debt) per vault, aggregated over the account's NFT positions. The VaultResolver is the chain-level constant pinned in the constructor; the active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is a T1 vault address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = collSym/debtSym. Supersedes the per-vault Fluid_Vault_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11). T1 vaults only.

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Compound V3 (Comet) market. Emits base Supply/Borrow + per-collateral Collateral + COMP Rewards legs per comet. CometRewards + reward token (COMP) are chain-level constants pinned in the constructor; the active comet set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is a comet address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = comet address; name = comet name(). Supersedes the per-comet CompoundV3_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every StakeWise V3 vault. Emits a Staking leg (vault shares) and a Borrow leg (osToken debt) per vault, both denominated in the underlying staking asset. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below). underlyingToken is the chain-level constant (ETH sentinel on mainnet). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = vault name(). Supersedes the per-vault StakeWiseV3Vault_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

EulerVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Euler V2 ERC4626 vault — EulerEarn aggregators (Earn) and core eVaults (Lend/Borrow). Active vault set lives on NAVCalculator via addMetaInstances (from nav-config). Emits a Supply leg (convertToAssets) and, for core eVaults the account borrows from, a Borrow leg (debtOf).

UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every configured Uniswap V3 pool via on-chain NFT enumeration (NPM is ERC721Enumerable). Reverts the interim assisted UniswapV3PoolsAssisted. NonfungiblePositionManager pinned in the constructor; the active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (nav-config instances). 04 reads positionManager (the display name is derived from _protocolId(), not configured).

SymbioticVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving Symbiotic ERC-4626 vaults. Active vault set lives on NAVCalculator via addMetaInstances (from nav-config). ERC-4626 vaults only - a Symbiotic CORE vault (epoch-based activeBalanceOf + withdrawal queue) is out of scope and would contribute nothing rather than a wrong number.

YoVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving YO Protocol vaults (YoVault). Per vault it emits up to two Supplied legs in the vault asset under positionId abi.encode(vault): held shares (previewRedeem, fee-net, isLocked=false) and the account's pending escrowed redeem (min(net-of-fee reservation, previewRedeem(shares)), isLocked=true). CREATE2 with a NAV-only constructor (DeploySalts.YO_VAULTS_META = 1), so the address is fleet-wide and known before the deploy. YO's Morpho Vault V2 (YO Ecosystem) is a genuine Morpho vault and stays on MorphoVaultsMeta.

PolygonStakingMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Polygon PoS ValidatorShare. NOTE THE CHAIN - Polygon PoS staking is settled on ETHEREUM L1 by StakeManager 0x5e3Ef299fDDf15eAa0432E6e66473ace8c13D908, which mints one ValidatorShare per validator; this is a chain-1 adapter despite the protocol's name. Emits a Staking leg (delegated principal) and a Rewards leg (unclaimed rewards) per validator, both denominated in POL. underlyingToken is POL and is independently checkable: StakeManager.token() returns exactly this address (verified on-chain 2026-08-26). It is passed rather than derived to match the family idiom and to avoid pinning the StakeManager too; ValidatorShare.polToken() is NOT a usable source - it returns address(0) on the live contracts. The active validator set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from nav-config). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = ValidatorShare address.

AaveSavingsWalletMeta.$comment: Wallet-held yield tokens (ADR 0010 meta family). Reports the RAW balanceOf of a token that is itself a registered, priced NAV asset, so the reported amount is bit-identical to what ERC20DefaultBalanceAdapter reported for the same holding - this reclassifies sGHO (Aave) from a generic wallet holding to a Supplied position and changes NO value. Constructor takes only the NAV proxy, so the CREATE2 address is identical on every chain. The governed token set lives on NAVCalculator (see nav-config); claiming a token there automatically disarms the default adapter for it, so the two can never both report the same holding.
